mapper.select: SELECT ID,PROJECT_ID,BIDDER_NAME,IP_ADDRESS,HANDLER_NAME,FILE_NAME,FILE_EXTENSION,CONTENT_TYPE,FILE_SIZE,SHA256,STORAGE_KEY,PARSED_TEXT,CREATED_TIME FROM PROCUREMENT_COLLUSION_DOCUMENT WHERE PROJECT_ID=#{projectId} ORDER BY CREATED_TIME,ID
mapper.update: MERGE INTO PROCUREMENT_COLLUSION_ASSESSMENT target USING (SELECT #{projectId,jdbcType=VARCHAR} AS PROJECT_ID FROM DUAL) source ON (target.PROJECT_ID = source.PROJECT_ID) WHEN MATCHED THEN UPDATE SET target.ID=#{id}, target.RISK_SCORE=#{riskScore}, target.RISK_LEVEL=#{riskLevel}, target.QUOTE_CV=#{quoteCoefficientOfVariation,jdbcType=DECIMAL}, target.MAX_DOCUMENT_SIMILARITY=#{maxDocumentSimilarity}, target.DUPLICATE_IP_GROUPS=#{duplicateIpGroups}, target.DUPLICATE_HANDLER_GROUPS=#{duplicateHandlerGroups}, target.SIMILARITIES_JSON=#{similaritiesJson,jdbcType=CLOB}, target.ASSESSED_TIME=#{assessedTime} WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN INSERT (ID,PROJECT_ID,RISK_SCORE,RISK_LEVEL,QUOTE_CV,MAX_DOCUMENT_SIMILARITY, DUPLICATE_IP_GROUPS,DUPLICATE_HANDLER_GROUPS,SIMILARITIES_JSON,ASSESSED_TIME) VALUES (#{id},#{projectId},#{riskScore},#{riskLevel},#{quoteCoefficientOfVariation,jdbcType=DECIMAL}, #{maxDocumentSimilarity},#{duplicateIpGroups},#{duplicateHandlerGroups}, #{similaritiesJson,jdbcType=CLOB},#{assessedTime})

MERGE INTO PROCUREMENT_SPLIT_PURCHASE_ASSESSMENT target USING (SELECT #{projectId,jdbcType=VARCHAR} AS PROJECT_ID FROM DUAL) source ON (target.PROJECT_ID = source.PROJECT_ID) WHEN MATCHED THEN UPDATE SET target.ID=#{id}, target.RISK_SCORE=#{riskScore}, target.RISK_LEVEL=#{riskLevel}, target.FINDINGS_JSON=#{findingsJson,jdbcType=CLOB}, target.ASSESSED_TIME=#{assessedTime} WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN INSERT (ID,PROJECT_ID,RISK_SCORE,RISK_LEVEL,FINDINGS_JSON,ASSESSED_TIME) VALUES (#{id},#{projectId},#{riskScore},#{riskLevel},#{findingsJson,jdbcType=CLOB},#{assessedTime})
